posts.t:
In case you missed it, before he got sent down to the AHL, Nikita Tolopilo played a hell of a game for the #Canucks.

And I watched it. dailyhive.com/vancouver/i-...

Ahead of the season, #Canucks GM Ryan Johnson said he doesn't believe in yo-yo-ing players up and down between the AHL and NHL.

But now it looks like Nikita "Yo-Yo" Tolopilo will be doing exactly that. dailyhive.com/vancouver/wh...

Absolutely outstanding performance by Nikita Tolopilo in his first game of the season. 

34 saves on 36 shots, including some utter robberies, to earn the one-goal win. #Canucks
Tolopilo is having himself a *game* out there. #Canucks
Malhotra has repeatedly harped on about dumb penalties being costly. Oleksiak just cost Tolopilo his shutout bid with that one. #Canucks

Tolopilo keeps the #Canucks in the game long enough for the power play to give him a lead to work with.

Great work by DeBrusk in front to keep his stick free and a nice pass by Boeser.
Canucks have recalled goaltender Nikita Tolopilo from Abbotsford.
